verdict.rationale: Featurebase ships its own AI agent (Fibi), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents MCP client support or connecting external tool servers. Webhooks, APIs, the Training Data API and generic integrations are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
